Subject: Thank you for the mock interview feedback

Hi Lena,

Thank you so much for the feedback after our Tuesday 3 p.m. mock interview today. I really appreciate you keeping this standing slot every week. Making me answer "tell me about yourself" standing up felt ridiculous at first but it genuinely helped, I could feel my voice steady out. My second-round video interview with Harrowgate Distribution was tonight and I just finished it, and a lot of what we practiced came up. I will let you know how it goes.

Best,
Arjun
